statement: You are given a binary array nums, in which every element is 0 or 1.
Return the length of the longest run of adjacent elements that are all 1.

examples.explanation: The 1s at indices 3 to 5 form a run of three. The other runs have lengths 2 and 1.
Every 1 is separated from the next by a 0, so the longest run has length 1.
